releaseNotes:
## 2.0.0-beta.28 - 2026-09-02

- Treats one Agent/workspace scope as one durable virtual server for both
  Codex and OpenCode: concurrent conversations share the same physical
  sandbox, filesystem, Gateway, and native Harness service while retaining
  independent Run state, native Thread or Session, model lease, tools,
  approval continuation, message stream, and dynamic Bridge port
- Makes AgentOS the common approval authority for both Harnesses. Policy-safe
  operations continue automatically, high-risk operations render one approval,
  and OpenCode reuses that single decision when one native tool call requests
  multiple underlying permissions
- Routes every OpenCode model request and AgentOS Host Tool through
  session-scoped state in the shared native Server, preventing concurrent
  conversations from exchanging model credentials, tool catalogs, or relay
  endpoints
- Activates Skill and memory projections atomically by content fingerprint and
  skips unchanged copies. A changed Skill generation waits for the active
  workspace cohort to finish before the next conversation uses it
- Migrates existing conversations across local or Cube template generations by
  draining or safely interrupting active Runs, clearing stale Harness resume
  state, restoring the durable workspace, and retiring old-template sandboxes
- Uses reference-counted dynamic ports for concurrent local-sandbox Bridges and
  binds Cube model relays directly to the acquired sandbox instead of resolving
  them by an ambiguous workspace lookup
- Ships with AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.11`, containing the matching Codex and
  OpenCode recipes plus the pinned Runtime toolchain
- Does not change the public TypeScript or Java SDK request/response schemas

### Verification

- Passed the complete production build and all 364 TypeScript, Server, UI,
  Harness, Runtime, and TypeScript SDK tests
- Passed real-browser Codex and OpenCode high-risk approval continuation,
  low-risk automatic execution, and concurrent same-workspace conversation
  checks without duplicate messages, approvals, or timers
- Passed the complete Go Runtime suite and all 10 Java SDK tests
- Passed 97 focused installer, release, Runtime bundle, template migration,
  shared-workspace, model-routing, Skill, memory, and approval tests
- Passed signed local `2.0.0-beta.27` to `2.0.0-beta.28` offline upgrade,
  packaged macOS Runtime command checks, and a real ARM64/glibc 2.28 Linux
  Core upgrade with a healthy persistent service
